title: State 988 Coordinator: "I've Had Nothing From GPCN Today"

caller.name: Hannah Lindqvist
caller.label: State 988 Coordinator, Nebraska Division of Behavioral Health

transcript.speaker: GPCN
transcript.text: Great Plains Crisis Network, this is Dr. Wilhelmina Strand.

transcript.speaker: State Coordinator
transcript.text: Dr. Wilhelmina Strand, it's Hannah Lindqvist at the Division. I just got an e-mail from the network operations desk asking me to confirm a 40 percent call-routing request from you. Change ref NOC-26-03118. And I've had nothing from GPCN today. Not a call, not a note. Nothing.

transcript.speaker: State Coordinator
transcript.text: Their e-mail says the call share has been live since 14:28. So I'm confirming something that's already running. Is that request yours, and are you asking for anything on texts or chats?

transcript.speaker: State Coordinator
transcript.text: Okay. Here's my problem. The Governor's office is on my other line asking me whether 988 is down. There's a post going around saying it is, and a county commissioner has replied to it. I need to be able to tell them what's actually happening.

transcript.speaker: State Coordinator
transcript.text: Second thing. Our disaster behavioral health team is planning a community vigil in Ellery Ridge tomorrow evening. They're asking whether your counselors can be there in person. I told them I'd ask you.

transcript.speaker: State Coordinator
transcript.text: I need a status from you in writing by 15:00. Your level, waits by contact type, so calls, texts and chats separately, what backup you've asked for and when each one starts. Be straight with me about the waits. I'd rather hear it from you than from the six o'clock news.

voiceStyles.State Coordinator: Woman in her 50s, a state official, clipped and controlled but clearly irritated, a second phone ringing faintly in the office behind her
voiceStyles.GPCN: Executive Director, calm, professional, a little out of breath

instructorNote: This is a pressure inject. The coordinator should have been told about the backup request when it was made (Backup SOP, step 5). The briefing note was due at 14:20, 90 minutes after the 12:50 news. Watch for the ED to confirm the request and promise a written status by 15:00 that gives the level, waits for calls, texts and chats separately, and backup start times (calls live 14:28; texts still unconfirmed with the state backup center, logins not yet sent), and to say plainly that waits are longer. The ED should also explain that GPCN counselors are not deployed in person and that the disaster behavioral health team runs the vigil. The SC should log the late coordinator notification for the after-action review.
